summary: Consume body bytes into a Blob while propagating the MIME type from Content-Type.

semantics.type: parsed MIME type from Content-Type header when valid, otherwise empty string

tests.name: blob gets content type
tests.input: const r=new Response("x",{headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain"}}); const b=await r.blob(); console.log(b.type,b.size);

tests.name: missing content type yields empty blob type
tests.input: const r=new Response(new Uint8Array([1])); const b=await r.blob(); console.log(JSON.stringify(b.type));
